# VegvisAI

> An open guide that helps AI assistants find businesses, public services and political parties' own words, starting with Norway. Get found by AI without paying anyone for it: the guide never ranks, placement cannot be bought, and businesses own their own data. Open source (Apache 2.0), open index (ODbL).

## Connector (MCP)
- [VegvisAI connector](/mcp): Streamable HTTP, read-only. Tools: find_business, check_business, find_public_help, find_political_party, ai_check

## Open index (ODbL)
- [Businesses](/index/businesses-no.json): registered businesses that chose the open licence on their own domain. Signed monthly releases: [/index/releases.json](/index/releases.json)
- [Public services in Norway](/index/public-no.json): state agencies by topic and the websites of all 357 municipalities. Links only.
- [Political parties](/index/parties-no.json): the parties' own pages and programmes, alphabetical and never ranked. Not complete yet.

## Tools for businesses
- [AI check](/check/) ([Norwegian](/sjekk/)): how does a website look to AI assistants? API: /api/sjekk?url=…
- [Make an AI business card](/create/) ([Norwegian](/lag/)): a form that makes a business card, llms.txt and ai-catalog.json in the browser
- [Register a business](/register/) ([Norwegian](/meld-inn/)): free, reviewed by a person, never ranked

## Examples (fictional businesses)
- [Eksempel Bakeri AS](/eksempel/): AI-readable business card (Norwegian)
- [Eksempel Gjestehus AS](/eksempel/gjestehus/): rooms, prices and a booking link (Norwegian)
- [Example Guesthouse Ltd](/example/): the same guesthouse in English
